silmaril_3_0_final_handoff.preface:
This document is the honest, complete state of SILMARIL 3.0 as of RC8, written to hand to a final coding agent. It lists exactly what is wired into the live 4-book paper-trading brain, what is NOT, what is dead legacy code, and the prioritized fix list. No fluff. Every claim below was verified by reading the actual repo (July 3 11:20 PM backup) + running the paper cycle, not from memory.
ARCHITECTURE IN ONE PARAGRAPH: Four independent $10k paper books (crypto/stock/metal/energy) run in silmaril/execution/paper_sim.py::live_step. Each has its own universe, arena, champion, and regime. A Master Account (silmaril/execution/master_account.py) is a high-confidence AGGREGATOR — it funds a book only at confidence >= 90 AND regime not DOWNTREND. Champions are elected per book by forward survivability. Everything is deterministic; no LLM in any signal path. The dashboard is docs/index.html reading JSON files from docs/data/. GitHub Actions runs it: daily.yml every 10 min (FAST trade cycle), analytics.yml 3x/day (heavy backtests + prune), backfill nightly.

what_is_wired_and_working.item: 4-book live trading: entry (conviction-ranked MR dips), exit (target or heatshield floor, NO timeouts), per-book champion params. WIRED.
MIN_TAKEHOME floor sizing — no more $0.01 dust buys. WIRED + verified.
Falling-knife veto (skip names down >=6%/6h with no bounce). WIRED, validated on WLD.
Stock long-term law: never buy a name whose daily-candle trend is down, and never buy blind (<20 daily candles = veto). WIRED.
Regime hard-gate: DOWNTREND + gate=hard => zero new entries, blocked candidates logged to REGIME_AB.json for A/B scoring. WIRED + verified.
Every trade stamped with entry_regime, wager_usd, conviction, target/stop at entry; realized_pct + pct_of_goal at exit. WIRED.

Regime read: INTRADAY-ONLY (daily-candle pollution bug FIXED in RC6), multi-timeframe 1h/6h/24h + breadth + movers(top-decile) + volatility. WIRED + verified. This was the biggest bug — it made green days read DOWNTREND.
Confidence gate + regime veto + per-cycle decision ledger (MASTER_DECISIONS.json). WIRED + verified.
NYSE holiday/half-day awareness; equity books idle when closed, crypto 24/7. WIRED.
280-strategy arena (drop/bounce/stop grid) driven by PARAM_CATALOG.json; compact grid hourly, full WIDE grid daily. WIRED.

Experimental-signal gating (news/dr_strange/lifecycle/fingerprint/regime_conditioning/ipo/heatshield_autotune/stock_news/rotation) — all in OBSERVE, nothing touches decisions until evidence clears promotion rule. WIRED.
90-day news evidence ledger (tags headlines to universe, scores vs price). WIRED, observe-only.
Binance.US output preview (LIVE_ORDERS_PREVIEW.json) — exact would-be order stream; enabled=false. WIRED.
Wipe purges books + Master + all derived views (session/trace/overlays/AB/kraken/threshold/sweeps). WIRED + verified.
Repo data-diet: trims intraday, caps ledgers, never touches dailies or snapshot proof. WIRED.

UI panels wired to real engine: LIVE REGIME, DENIED THIS CYCLE, FIRST-TRADE READINESS, MASTER ACCEPT/REJECT LEDGER, WIRING AUDIT, engine strip, System Brain (knobs+gates+health), Binance lock card. WIRED (RC6/RC7).
FAST-CYCLE GUARD — heavy intelligence builders (news/IPO/catalyst/deal-journal/event) gated OFF the 10-min cycle to stop cron stacking. WIRED in RC7.

dead_legacy_code.summary: There is a SECOND, parallel trading engine in silmaril/portfolios/ — the original Alpaca multi-agent system (agents named SCROOGE, MIDAS, CRYPTOBRO, Baron, Steadfast; $10k "career portfolios"; sgov sweep caps; composite halts). It is NOT the 4-book paper sim. It still runs inside cli.py and wrote ~13 JSON files that polluted the UI (the sgov/blocked_alpaca ACCEPT/REJECT counters the operator kept seeing). RC8 deleted those files, swapped the crypto-quadrant ledger for the real master gate, and neutralized the file writers. But the COMPUTE still runs (27 `from .portfolios` imports remain in cli.py, lines ~1391-2440), wasting cron time and coupling risk.
dead_legacy_code.task: Fully excise the silmaril/portfolios/ agent system from cli.py. The block runs roughly lines 1391-2440 (per-agent $10k portfolios, agent voting, agent risk, grade-weighting). It is interwoven with charts.json and benchmarking, so excise carefully: remove the agent-portfolio loop, save_portfolios, agent_risk, grade-weighting, and all `from .portfolios.*` imports that feed ONLY the agent system. KEEP: market_calendar, anything the 4-book sim imports. TEST after: `python -c "from silmaril.execution.paper_sim import live_step; live_step('docs/data')"` must still run clean.

Delete the silmaril/portfolios/ directory entirely once L1 is done and nothing imports it. Also delete silmaril/execution/alpaca_paper.py and any alpaca_*.py. Grep-verify: `grep -rn "portfolios\|alpaca\|sgov\|harvest" silmaril/ docs/index.html` returns nothing.

Delete remaining legacy files listed in DELETE_THESE_LEGACY_FILES.txt from the repo (GitHub web UI): decision_ledger.json, capital_flow.json, agent_portfolios.json, report_card.json, harvest_*.json, alpaca_*_state.json, wantgot.json, debug_stream.json, docs/data/archive/.

systems_built_but_not_fully_wired_to_dec.note: These COMPUTE and DISPLAY but do not yet CHANGE trading behavior. That is BY DESIGN (observe-first), but the operator wants each to eventually rotate in via the feature-gate promotion mechanism once it proves edge on real forward data. None can be promoted until data accrues over the observation window.
systems_built_but_not_fully_wired_to_dec.item: Dr. Strange (trajectory/next-peak projection) — computes, gated observe, evidence ledger empty (needs forward data). Not validated.
Peak-rhythm / fingerprint — computed and DISPLAYED, ranks entries via conviction, but fingerprint-WEIGHTING of entries is gated observe (not yet influencing).
News ingestion — all-quadrant tagging works; influence gated until 60 scored headlines beat coin-flip p<0.05. Historically failed; restarted clean.
Regime A/B proof (REGIME_AB_STATUS.json) — logs blocked trades, scores them vs reality. Only populates on DOWNTREND+hard-gate days. Verify it fires on the next red crypto day.

IPO/event watch — feature-gate slot exists (ipo_event_watch, observe) but there is NO live IPO data fetcher wired to the 4-book engine. If wanted, build a deterministic fetcher; otherwise remove the slot to avoid implying a capability that isn't there.
Time-of-day edge, heatshield autotune, lifecycle, regime_conditioning — all gated observe, evidence 0/N. Promotion is automatic once evidence clears; no action needed except letting data accrue.

operational_guidance.reset_policy: Install RC8, reset ONCE (clears cached legacy ledger from quadrant pages), then let it run untouched. After the final agent's excision pass, reset once more for a truly clean 90-day baseline.
operational_guidance.warmup: After reset, crypto arms in ~2h (24 intraday points at 10-min cadence). Stock/metal/energy only when their data feeds return (Monday for equities). The FIRST-TRADE READINESS panel shows the countdown per book.
operational_guidance.honest_status: This is a legitimate research platform with a corrected regime engine, honest evidence gating, and a working crypto book. It is NOT yet a proven trading system — that requires the 90-day observation window with 100 OOS trades clearing the survivability gate. The $600-4500/month target remains an unproven hypothesis the data will confirm or deny. No code can shortcut that.
